agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking 6BPGMP on SF-331; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Saffron Air: I request INR 13,600.00 for the cancellation of SF-331 (PNR 6BPGMP) on 11 Jul 2026.
